New MLBB heroes 2026: releases, revamps and what comes next

Hirara, Marcel, Sora and the Masha and Bruno revamps: release dates from patch notes, current win and ban rates and what is known about the next hero.

In this story

  1. New heroes and revamps by date
  2. How the new heroes perform now
  3. When the next new hero comes out
← All news

In brief

  • The latest new hero is Hirara, a jungle assassin. She was released on 17 June 2026 with patch 2.1.88.
  • Since December 2025 three new heroes have come out: Sora, Marcel and Hirara. Four more were revamped: Eudora, Aulus, Masha and Bruno.
  • Hirara is banned in 68% of matches, the highest ban rate among all 133 heroes.
  • As of 22 November MOONTON has not announced the next hero. The latest official patch notes are 2.2.16 from 16 September.

A new Mobile Legends hero arrives with a major patch, and for the first weeks it is either banned or picked in every other game. We collected every new and revamped hero from the last year and a half, checked the dates against the official patch notes and looked at how they perform now in MOONTON statistics.

The latest patch with a revamp came for the game's tenth anniversary: 2.2.16 updated Masha and Bruno and gave six more heroes new art. That patch had no new hero.

The tier is our grade by win rate: S from 53%, A from 51%, B below. Data as of 21 November 2026.

The revamps worked out better than the new releases. After her update Masha wins 60.47% of matches and ranks first among all heroes, and Bruno and Aulus are in S tier too. Among the new heroes Marcel stands out: 57.49% wins and second place overall, even though he is rarely picked.

Why Hirara is banned at a 50% win rate

Hirara's win rate is average, yet she is removed in the draft in 68% of matches. That is how players usually treat heroes that are unpleasant to face: a jungle assassin picks off weak targets quickly, and many would rather not find out whether the opponent can play her.

When the next new hero comes out

In 2025 and 2026 new heroes arrived about once every three months: in June, September and December 2025, then in March and June 2026. Since Hirara there has been no new hero for five months. There is no official announcement as of 22 November, so we will not name a hero or a date: rumours about new heroes are often wrong.

As soon as MOONTON publishes patch notes with a new hero, we will update this article and its tables. The easiest place to follow announcements is the Patch section on the game's official site.
